errata.reason: Source-review correction, 2026-11-11: SMPL-FCST-001 attaches an unsupported causal sequence to its otherwise unchanged FQ4 FY2026 in-range forecast. The saved steps place deliberate under-shipment in FQ3 and Q4 shipment normalization after that reset. The cited July 9 CFO remarks instead describe management's belief that it would slightly undership consumption in FQ4 to enter FY2027 with correctly organized and sized customer inventories; part related to expected OWYN distribution losses. This is a planned FQ4 shipment gap, not demonstrated execution, a completed FQ3 reset, a quantified inventory effect, or evidence of Q4 demand recovery. Q4 normalization is not proven by the cited sources. This documentation-only note does not replace the causal_steps, change the published 60% probability, guidance ranges, triggers, dates, decision, conviction, or any outcome review. It does not supersede the call or establish better forecasting or investment performance.
